# Ahmad Farooq

> Systems engineer based in Lahore, Pakistan. Builds websites, internal tools and AI workflows. Runs Zotir Labs and co-founded Kaivex Systems.

Ahmad Farooq builds websites and the systems behind them: internal tools, automations and AI workflows. He is the founder of Zotir Labs, a web agency, and co-founder of Kaivex Systems, an e-commerce growth agency.

## Work

- [Zotir Labs](https://ahmadfarooq.vercel.app/work/zotir-labs): Brand, design system and website for a web agency
- [Kaivex Systems](https://ahmadfarooq.vercel.app/work/kaivex): E-commerce growth agency website rebuilt as a multi-page store-first site
- [Kai](https://ahmadfarooq.vercel.app/work/kai): 10-agent AI platform for outreach, habits, CRM and chat
- [Blackbox](https://ahmadfarooq.vercel.app/work/blackbox): Landing page conversion scanner
